name: firespitter_whelp_dragon_spells_and_your_noncreature_spells
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever you cast a noncreature or Dragon spell, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.' Seat 0 controls one Firespitter Whelp and casts a second one, a Dragon creature spell: the first deals 1 to seat 1 (the second is on the stack, not on the battlefield). Seat 0's Savannah Lions (a creature spell, no Dragon) does nothing, and neither does seat 1's Opt (an opponent's noncreature spell). Seat 1 ends at 19, seat 0 at 20.
